=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1060-1069 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED=true` is written to `$GITHUB_ENV` (line 1065) when `answer-release` decides `release=true`, which happens before the `gh_retry gh issue edit` that removes `ai:scope-blocked` (lines 1068-1069). That edit's failure is swallowed by `|| true`. The handler then forces `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING=false` (lines 2418-2424) on the strength of an unconfirmed removal.
  WHY: If the release edit fails, two paths follow. (a) The re-plan succeeds and adds `ai:awaiting-approval` (plan.yml:3107-3109) with a stale `ai:scope-blocked`, and implement.yml:2400-2404 then refuses implementation. (b) The re-plan blocks on scope again and the handler's edit or comment post fails; the rollback (lines 2435-2437) then strips a latch that was never released, `override_guard` is no longer offered, and the `/answer` scope-widening path is lost. Severity: gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at this same path and did not raise it as a defect: it called the effect narrow, said it needs several failures in one job and is not new, and recorded it only as a hardening suggestion.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1048-1069 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `release=true`, the validate step issues one combined `gh issue edit` (add `ai:planning`, remove `ai:blocked`, remove `ai:scope-blocked`), swallowed by `|| true`. `gh` applies label adds and removes as separate requests, so the edit can fail partially, and nothing checks that `ai:scope-blocked` was actually removed before the flag is written.
  WHY: A `release=true` decision does not guarantee the latch is gone, and the same five-precondition failure path applies. The suggested fix is a dedicated `--remove-label 'ai:scope-blocked'` call, with the flag written only if that call succeeds.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2398-2443 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The handler's best-effort rollback assumes the whole `gh issue edit` failed. It removes `ai:scope-blocked` whenever `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING != "true"`, even when the failure was on a different label change and the scope label was added successfully.
  WHY: After such a partial failure the issue carries `ai:blocked` and possibly a scope-block marker comment, but no `ai:scope-blocked`. `latest_rejection` then refuses the marker as untrusted, `stop_for_labels` returns `blocked`, and the issue stalls. This can happen through label-validation rules or rate limits.
- tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py:970-977 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_failed_comment_post_removes_only_the_scope_label_this_run_added` asserts that the rollback fires when `PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED=true`. It does not separate a successful validate edit from a failed one, so it locks in the decision-time flag behaviour.
  WHY: No test checks that a failed validate edit leaves the flag unwritten and the rollback unfired, so the bug can come back after a fix.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2398-2443 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` (from `scripts/label_helpers.sh`) runs `gh label create`, a write call. That conflicts with the PR description's first-iteration promise of "0 new API calls", while the changelog fragment now lists "1 label create per routed block, 1 identity read per `/answer` on an `ai:scope-blocked` issue".
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime; this is documentation/contract drift (NIT).
- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:psbr_route (`if not isinstance(meta, dict) or "pull_request" in meta: emit(False, "not_an_issue", 0)`) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `pull_request` is detected by key membership alone, so any future field with that name would trigger the `not_an_issue` rejection.
  WHY: This is a defensive concern only; today's API shape never produces such a dict (NIT).
- agents.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md, README.md:"Planning scope routing" bullet / "Resumption" bullet; PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED row | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The docs, and the past-tense flag name, say `PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED=true` is written when the `/answer` release "removed" the latch. plan.yml:1061-1065 actually writes it at decision time, before the removal edit, whose result is discarded with `|| true`.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but operators and maintainers will reason from a false premise ("confirmed removal") about the release-then-reblock rollback path. All four reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "§15: no new GitHub API calls. Companion entries are added to the body before the existing `gh issue create`. The marker is part of the comment plan.yml already posts, and `ai:scope-blocked` is added in the same `gh issue edit` that adds `ai:blocked` today. The label is created with the existing `ensure_label_exists` helper only when it is absent; that helper's read already runs for `ai:blocked`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, the "Validate planning phase label" step (conditional identity read at line 1060) and the "Handle blocked planning output" step (`ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` at line 2408)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: All five reviewers report the new `gh_retry gh api user --jq .login` at plan.yml:1060. It runs on an `/answer` when the issue carries `ai:scope-blocked` and feeds `PLAN_SCOPE_PIPELINE_LOGIN` to `answer-release`. Gemini, minimax and luna also report `ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked"` at plan.yml:2408: per luna, `scripts/label_helpers.sh:193-213` implements it as `gh label create` rather than reusing the `ai:blocked` read; per sonnet, the line-176 helper caches per label name, so the new label costs its own create; per minimax, it runs only inside the `SCOPE_ROUTE_ACTIVE` guard. Sonnet and glm treat the label create as allowed by the issue text and count only the identity read as the gap. Sonnet, minimax and glm note that the deviation is already documented (README row, changelog fragment) and was recorded as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED. Severity split: NIT from sonnet, minimax and luna; MAJOR from gemini and glm.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md and agents.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md:The README PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED row says "(or an `/answer` release earlier in the same job removed it)". The agents.d "Planning scope routing" bullet says "unless an `/answer` release earlier in the same job removed that latch (the validate step then writes `PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED=true` to `$GITHUB_ENV` ...)". | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both docs say the flag means the release succeeded. In .github/workflows/plan.yml it is written at line 1065, inside the release=true branch and before the edit at lines 1068-1069, whose result is discarded with "|| true", so it records a decision, not a removal.
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime. Operators will assume a confirmed removal, but the handler's rollback also fires when the release edit failed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "§15: no new GitHub API calls. ... The label is created with the existing ensure_label_exists helper only when it is absent; that helper's read already runs for ai:blocked."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/plan.yml, the "Validate planning phase label" step (the conditional identity read at line 1060).
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds `gh_retry gh api user --jq .login` at line 1060, which runs on an /answer when the metadata has ai:scope-blocked. The ensure_label_exists "ai:scope-blocked" call is allowed by the issue text, but scripts/label_helpers.sh ensure_label_exists (line 176) caches per label name, so it costs its own `gh label create`. Earlier editor rounds recorded this deviation as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, and it is documented in the README row and the changelog fragment.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOTE: The reviewer examined the pass-1 consensus on PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED ordering (plan.yml line 1065 before lines 1068-1069 "|| true"; line 2422 forces SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING=false) and did not raise it as a defect. Reasons given: the effect is narrow; the rollback needs several failures in one job; the stale-latch path predates this PR; and moving the flag would not make it exact.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: .github/workflows/plan.yml "Validate planning phase label", lines 1061-1069. The flag is written before the release edit and the edit's failure is swallowed silently. Suggested fix: keep the decision-based flag, replace "|| true" with a branch that emits a ::warning:: "PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK release edit failed issue=${ISSUE_NUMBER}" when PLAN_SCOPE_RELEASE_ARGS is non-empty, or document the flag as "decided". Estimated lines changed: 4. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:~1066 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gh issue edit command that removes ai:scope-blocked uses || true, so any failure is swallowed.
  WHY: If the removal fails, PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED is already set while the label stays on the issue. Later handlers may then assume the latch was cleared, which can lead to an invalid latch removal in rollback or a refused dispatch.
- README.md / agents.d/9534-judge-scope-gaps.md:README.md row for PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED, agents fragment "Resumption" bullet. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The docs imply the release removed the label ("an /answer release earlier in the same job removed it"), while the code only tracks that it decided to release.
  WHY: Operators may troubleshoot on the false assumption that a release decision means the label was removed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: §15: No new GitHub API calls.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/plan.yml
  Evidence of absence: The diff introduces new gh api user calls at line 1060 and ensure_label_exists (which executes gh label create) at line 2408. These new API requests are not batched with existing ones, which violates the hard constraint of reusing existing calls.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
